description.zh: 智能识别警情、案件、人员数据中的潜在风险点与异常特征，自动打风险标签，辅助事前预警。
description.en: Detect risks and anomalies in incident, case and personnel data, auto-apply risk tags for early warning.

welcome_message.zh: 提供数据与风险关注点，我来识别风险并打标签
welcome_message.en: Share data and risk concerns — I'll detect risks and tag them

description.zh: 输入：警情/案件/人员数据、风险关注点与阈值。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 risk-report.html（风险标签与分级）与 risk-rules.json
description.en: Input: incident/case/personnel data, risk concerns and thresholds. Output: risk-report.html (tags and levels) and risk-rules.json under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请对以下数据做风险标注。

数据（警情/案件/人员记录）：

风险关注点与阈值规则：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 risk-report.html（逐条风险标签、异常特征与分级依据）和 risk-rules.json（规则配置）。仅辅助事前预警，结论需标注"仅供人工复核，不作为执法依据"。
prompt.en:
Please tag risks in the following data.

Data (incident/case/personnel records):

Risk concerns and threshold rules:

Expected output: risk-report.html (per-record risk tags, anomalies and grading rationale) and risk-rules.json under outbound/<task>/, marked "for human review only, not a basis for enforcement".
